shortDescription: Module to add edges to Skydive topology

options.name: child_node
options.description: To defined the second node of the link, it can be either an ID or a gremlin expression

options.name: host
options.description: To define the host of the node.

options.name: metadata
options.description: To define metadata for the edge.

options.name: parent_node
options.description: To defined the first node of the link, it can be either an ID or a gremlin expression

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: relation_type
options.description: To define relation type of the node I(ownership, layer2, layer3).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Skydive Edge. If value is I(present) new edge will be created else if it is I(absent) it will be deleted.
